question.prompt: After a translation, point \(A(1,1)\) corresponds to \(A'(4,-1)\). How many units to the right and how many units upward has the figure been translated? (Use a negative number for a downward translation. Answer in this order, separated by a comma.)

solutions.explanation: The horizontal coordinate changes from 1 to 4, so the translation is 3 units to the right. The vertical coordinate changes from 1 to \(-1\), so the translation is \(-2\) units upward (that is, 2 units downward).
solutions.title: Compare corresponding coordinates
